title: Karin Kiho: professional work first, then a grey 'Other Projects' band
note: The home is split in two tones. First 'Commercial and professional work.': a 2-column grid of big still thumbnails with title, year in mustard and #tags. Then the background turns warm grey (#e4e4e7) for 'Other Projects – hackathon, student, personal and experimental work', grouped by type (Art / Illustration / Motion, Sound × Interaction, XR / Game, Physical Computing) as small square thumbnails that alternate left and right. It ends on a stack of 'record sleeves' you can hover to pick a project. Worth reusing: the exact 'serious first, then look what I made' structure Petra wants, with a change of background marking the switch.
